title: [NSW, ACT, VIC, QLD, SA] Lager 24x375mL $38.50, Pale Ale $45, XPA $55, 50/50 IPA $69 + Delivery @ Hope Brewery
body:
Deal: [NSW, ACT, VIC, QLD, SA] Lager 24x375mL $38.50, Pale Ale $45, XPA $55, 50/50 IPA $69 + Delivery @ Hope Brewery

[Grannular] Shipping to Melbourne for a single case: $25.91
Kills this deal
[check] Last time you offered discount with code: OZBARGAIN
That made it a more attractive deal!
[Whomastadon] " Salted Caramel Hazy IIIPA Case "
I'm a craft beer enjoyer, there's no way this is good. Sounds like a complete oxy moron
[chickentaste] I thought so too until I tried it. Absolutely god-tier. Am seriously considering a whole case of the stuff.
[chickentaste] I really REALLY liked the mixed pack I bought before and would be happy to support you guys but I'm not paying $51.80 to send a case to FNQ. I'd put a bigger order together if you had a minimum threshold for free shipping (seems to sit at about 150 for other breweries).
[turboturbet] Passionfruit cider? Will this ever be in this sale?
[misterc] Are you still selling the Hope Estate merch? One of fave t-shirts got ruined.
[mett139] As much as I love the bevs Hope put out, the last time I visited I picked up a case of the lager on clearance and it was foul. You could have convinced me it was a kettle sour. Had to bin the whole thing when I got back to Sydney.
That said, I broke my favourite Hope tulip glass so I'll need to stop by next time I visit the region.
[silvion] Would love to support small brewery, especially from further away where I am. Unfortunately, as others have said, shipping is not worth it, even at spending $150+ on multiple cartons.
The $65 RRP a carton via Dan Murphys and $90 direct is a large difference and doesn't help validate the sale.
https://www.danmurphys.com.au/product/DM_811265/hope-brewery…
[Sp88ked] Please make the Imperial Pineys a sale item, it's all i dream of!
[thedavemiester] Wtf is going on with those shipping rates. Are they delivered by a majestical unicorn?
[Snoopy113] The quality of this brewery has been all over the place the last few years. And add to that, the owner is a complete knob.
[johnmelb] Was about to place a $400 order, then saw shipping $73.
No thanks.
Reduced my car to one case still more than $25 shipping, like others mentioned
